flows:
Navigate to https://www.colorhexa.com/ff6600 then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Open the color picker using the swatch next to the color search field.
Stop when the color spectrum panel and hue slider are visible.

remark: press_key: PRIMARY: press the Tab key
press_key: PRIMARY: press the Tab key
wait: Waiting after checking keyboard accessibility of the swatch

summary:
The visible color swatch is built so that Tab cannot reach it. As a result, a keyboard-only visitor has no way to open the color picker and see its spectrum and hue controls.
Make the swatch keyboard-focusable and support Enter and Space to open the color picker, with a visible focus indicator.
evidence: objective_contradiction: The visible swatch is a non-focusable div (tabIndex -1), so keyboard-only controls cannot open it.
one_liner: The color-picker swatch cannot receive keyboard focus, so the required keyboard-only flow cannot open the picker.
